# tone event is unpitched

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:toneEventIsUnpitched`](gmeow-toneEventIsUnpitched.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/toneEventIsUnpitched>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

True when this [`ToneEvent`](../classes/gmeow-ToneEvent.md) has no definite pitch (e.g. percussion, noise). Mutually exclusive with [`toneEventPitchValue`](gmeow-toneEventPitchValue.md) and [`toneEventPitchTrajectory`](gmeow-toneEventPitchTrajectory.md).
